title: Compare Victorian Public Library Visits per Resident
text: data come Public Libraries Victoria (PLV) Annual Statistical Survey, Final Datasets 2022-23 2024-25, available https://www.plv.org.au/resources/earlier-reports--surveys. Data © Public Libraries Victoria. script data-raw/library_visits.R downloads PLV workbook, calculates summaries saves summaries package. follows definitions PLV Library Statistics Benchmarking Report: Library visits = branch visits + mobile library visits. Visits per resident = library visits divided municipal population. Victorian figure = total Victorian visits divided total Victorian population. Main limitations: Visits count entries, different people. Councils many workers, students visitors can high visits per resident non-residents also use libraries. Indigo (2022-23) Towong (2022-23 2023-24) report data. PLV’s estimates observations used; rates NA. Cardinia Shire moved Casey-Cardinia Libraries (now Connected Libraries) Myli 1 December 2022. changed areas served, comparisons involving 2022-23 two services treated caution.
